messages:
incident-bot: Pager: cross-region routing alert — increased 5xx rates for APAC -> US-east flows; unexpected region drift detected. AlertID=RTE-2026-3832 :rotating_light:

meera: acked. i'm oncall. high-level: customers in apac seeing spike in errors when calling embeddings and long-polling streams. starting triage.

rick: joining. i can already see a spike in DNS NXDOMAIN temporarily then a burst of routing to us-east1. curious: did DNS change propagate?

jamie: no recent DNS config changes on the infra team. there was an AZ network blip in apac-sg at 03:10 that caused transient LB failover. logs show many clients retried and then hit us-east.

tia: checking router decision logs: a chunk of requests lost region_affinity cookie and fell back to consistent-hash->region selection which used geo-latency probe that was stale. snippet:

```
2026-03-15T03:11:02Z router-5 INFO  request=xyz client_ip=203.120.1.5 region_cookie=missing
2026-03-15T03:11:02Z router-5 DEBUG probe_cache_age=128s probe_latency_us-east=80 probe_latency-apac=95
2026-03-15T03:11:02Z router-5 INFO  choose_region=us-east reason=probe_latency
```

infra-bot: Note: apac-sg AZ reported 03:09:54 packet-loss spike -> partial LB failover. EventID=AZ-PKT-20260315-0310

meera: sounds like two contributing things: 1) AZ packet loss caused cookie/session loss; 2) probe cache staleness and a stale latency measurement nudged selection to us-east. That explains cross-region drift.

rick: mitigation idea A: force immediate probe refresh and invalidate probe cache so routing decisions use fresh latencies. mitigation idea B: pin rewrite — restore region_affinity based on client geo during the window. Which is safer?

jamie: probe refresh is low-risk, quick: will kick probes and expire cache. command:

```
infractl probe refresh --scope=apac --force
```

meera: do it. also set probe-cache-ttl shorter while we monitor:

```
infractl config set routing.probe_cache_ttl=15s
```

infra-bot: probe refresh started. expected probe round-trip ~30s.

comms: flagging possible customer outreach if impact >10% sessions or >15min window. drafting standby blurb.

tia: after probe refresh, early signs: region selection reweighted back to apac nodes. 5xx rate dropping from 3.5% -> 0.6%. p99 latency still elevated for a subset — probably client-side retries.

meera: good. action: keep probe_cache_ttl lowered for 2 hours and then revert. jamie, can you add a transient guard so that when region_cookie is missing we prefer geo-pin instead of probe if probe_cache_age > 60s? that's the root of the oscillation.

jamie: quick patch possible: comparator fallback order change. i'll open hotfix and push to canary then prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3022. will tag with CHERRY-PICK.

rick: also, we should surface more explicit metrics: count of requests with missing region_cookie per AZ and probe_cache_age distribution. adding dashboards now.

infra-bot: hotfix rollout started to canary (canary hosts: router-7, router-9).

incident-bot: Update: canary shows routing stable, error-rate down to 0.4% for canary slice. Proceeding with staged rollout.

meera: oncall handoff: @rick you'll be primary during the evening window; i'll follow up with post-incident items.

comms: drafting internal note now: brief impact summary and mitigation steps. preparing external customer note in case we exceed threshold.

jamie: full rollout complete at 03:36. infra-bot confirms config change applied to 100% routers.

tia: final metrics: total APAC sessions affected ~12% peak, error-rate normalized to baseline 0.18%, p95 latency returned close to normal. residual client retry errors ongoing for ~8 minutes post-mitigation.

meera: deciding severity: SEV3 due to regional impact and short duration. logging incident in tracker. action items:
  - postmortem owner: jamie
  - infra guard + unit tests to avoid probe-cache staleness regression: tia + jamie
  - dashboard + alert refinement (cookie-miss threshold): rick
  - customer comms draft + legal review if we go external: comms

rick: adding logs and packet-loss timeline to the incident ticket. will include LB failover traces.

comms: internal status posted. keeping external draft paused until we confirm customer list.

meera: thanks team. closing pager for now; reopen if metric regression within next 1h. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Incident closed (temporary) by meera. Reminder: attach PR and rollout snapshot to ticket.

jamie: i'll run a follow-up runbook rehearse for region-cookie loss scenario and add automated probe-cache invalidation when AZ health event detected.

tia: filing follow-up ticket with test cases and adding e2e for cookie-loss recovery.

meera: nice work, everyone.
